lead.summary: A Renfe AVE train struck a stationary Iryo train near Urda, Toledo province, on 28 October 2026, killing 69 people and injuring more than 100. The collision occurred after a failure in the LZB automatic train-control system forced controllers to authorize movements using alternative procedures.

stories.title: From Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes: India’s Bullet Train vision gets a major push, with Make in India at its core
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved the Northern Corridor of the bullet train network, connecting Delhi, Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Patna and Siliguri, with an extension to Guwahati. Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the project would be built under the Make in India vision, with construction components manufactured domestically.

stories.title: Views of Ashish Bansal: NFR’s vision for transformative rail connectivity
stories.summary: Ashish Bansal, General Manager, North Frontier Railway (Construction), stated that the current project portfolio spans 1,827 km of new line and doubling projects with an overall project cost of about Rs 961.41 billion. The five-year commissioning plan further envisages around 3,997 km new lines and doubling, and third and fourth line works planned across NFR (Construction) up to 2030-31.

stories.title: Renfe updates safety protocol as investigators analyse Urda collision
stories.summary: Renfe introduced a new safety directive requiring high-speed trains to halt and proceed at a maximum speed of 40 km/h under visual supervision after cab signalling failures. The decision follows the fatal Urda collision that killed at least 69 people.

stories.title: Early Uber Investor: Tesla and Uber Will “Split 80%” of the Robotaxi Market
stories.summary: Angel investor Jason Calacanis bought 15,000 Uber shares at $65 and 3,000 Tesla shares at $357, predicting Tesla and Uber will split 80% of the autonomous vehicle market. He forecasts Tesla will hold 40% and Uber 35% of the market, while Waymo will capture 15%.

stories.title: A3 Robot Safety Conference Opens Monday: North American Cobot Orders Surge 56%
stories.summary: North American manufacturers ordered 10,989 industrial robots worth $723.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, a 24.8% increase in units over the same period last year, according to the Association for Advancing Automation. Collaborative robot orders grew 56% year-over-year, driven by semiconductor and life sciences facilities that require cage-free automation to meet strict contamination standards.

also.title: Robot Orders Reach 11,000, Automation Association Says

stories.title: Perseus Defense tests cheap missile against drone
stories.summary: Perseus Defense released video of its low-cost interceptor hitting a hovering drone, a shot the company’s chief executive described as the first time an “attritable” missile has shot down a drone. The Texas-based firm aims for a price below $10,000 per shot for its Harpe missile, which is about 61 cm (24 inches) long with a stated range of 2 km (1.2 miles).

stories.title: Chess Dynamics introduces equipment support framework
stories.summary: Chess Dynamics launched ChessPlus, a support framework for its counter-uncrewed aerial systems equipment that helps customers plan for spares, repairs, and obsolescence before they impact system availability. The modular framework supports both new and existing systems, shifting emphasis from traditional after-sales support to continuing support throughout the system lifecycle.

stories.title: EURONAVAL 2026: KNDS AND SEAOWL PARTNER TO DEVELOP A SURFACE DRONE EQUIPPED WITH A NEXT-GENERATION NAVAL LOITERING MUNITION
stories.summary: KNDS and SeaOwl Technology Solutions signed a strategic cooperation agreement at Euronaval 2026 to develop an unmanned surface vehicle carrying a KNDS warhead. The vehicle reaches 35 knots, carries a 30 kg payload, and has a 200 km combat range.

stories.title: 80 kmph, 557 passengers! India's homegrown bullet train has some big surprises inside
stories.summary: BEML is building India's first indigenously designed bullet train at its Bengaluru facility for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor. The 202-metre-long, eight-coach train accommodates 557 passengers and is designed to reach a maximum testing speed of 280 kmph.

stories.title: NATO Tests 5G Networks and AI for Drone Detection in Baltic Exercise
stories.summary: NATO connected a Maven targeting system to a national military system using agentic artificial intelligence and conducted a cross-border drone interception during the DiBaX 2026 exercise in Latvia from October 19 to October 30. The alliance also tested commercial 5G networks for communications continuity and drone detection, with European Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis announcing two drone technology innovation centers in Latvia and the Netherlands for 2027.

stories.summary: Business Insider toured Amazon's fulfillment center in Tracy, California, where robots carry shelves and sort packages while thousands of people pick orders and clear jams. The facility is not fully automated, as workers step in when the automated system hits a problem it cannot solve.

stories.title: Laser weapons add another layer of security at Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate amid rising drone threats
stories.summary: NORAD and US northern command confirmed that the US Secret Service requested the deployment of an AeroVironment LOCUST laser system at President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida. Photographs taken on October 31 show the weapon mounted on a 4x4 Joint Light Tactical Vehicle, adding a layer to existing air-defence networks including Avenger systems and radar.

The company expects programming costs to fall by more than 50% and plans to train field engineers to implement these AI-based solutions.

stories.title: New ISO Interoperability Standard Helps Mobile Robots from Different Vendors Work Together
stories.summary: The Association for Advancing Automation (A3) announced the publication of ISO 21423:2026, an international standard establishing communication requirements for industrial mobile robots from different vendors. The standard specifies how robots, fleet managers, and other systems exchange information to improve availability and system efficiency in shared industrial environments.

also.title: A $373 ISO standard lets mobile robots from different vendors share a floor

stories.title: Ready for Takeoff: New Partnership Offers Students Hands-On Drone Training
Russia’s FSB says it intercepted shipment of booby-trapped FPV goggles meant for drone operators
stories.summary: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) seized a shipment of FPV drone-control goggles rigged with homemade explosives from multiple regions across the country. The agency stated that Ukrainian intelligence services installed the devices, which were set to detonate when the goggles were turned on, and sent them to Russian soldiers via Russian Post.

stories.title: Short line training centre funded for six years
stories.summary: The American Short Line & Regional Railroad Association received a $5.6m FY25-26 Consolidated Rail Infrastructure & Safety Improvements grant to expand its Short Line Training Center. Over six years, the funding will support at least 24 training programs, up to 48 in-person seminars, and new technology for course delivery.

stories.title: Cybercab Sightings Outside Austin Geofence Jump to 33 a Week
stories.summary: Robotaxi Tracker cameras logged 33 Cybercab sightings outside Tesla’s Austin service area during the week of October 26 through November 1, up from one the week of September 28. The tracker identified 27 engineering vehicle detections north of the fence along Anderson Mill, Parmer, Lakeline, and Highway 620, while Tesla has not confirmed when or whether those corridors will open to paying riders.

BMW Group Moves One Million Vehicles Without Drivers Across Four Production Plants
stories.summary: BMW Group announced the movement of one million vehicles across its BMW and MINI brands without drivers using its automated driving technology. The company expanded its Automated Driving In-Plant (AFW) technology to MINI Plant in the United Kingdom, joining its plants in Dingolfing, Leipzig and Regensburg, Germany, where approximately 3,500 automated vehicle movements take place daily.

stories.title: From 280 kmph speed, Wi-Fi to luxury seats: Inside India's first bullet train
stories.summary: Railways Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw visited the BEML facility in Bengaluru, where India's first indigenously designed bullet train is undergoing structural tests. The eight-coach train, built for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor, is designed for a maximum test speed of 280 kmph and will carry around 557 passengers.

stories.title: Waymo Robotaxis Are Blocking San Diego Streets, Leaving Drivers, Police And Tow Trucks To Deal With The Fallout
stories.summary: Waymo robotaxis have repeatedly blocked San Diego streets, including a two-hour stall on a Crown Point road and incidents in North Park and flooded coastal areas. These obstructions occurred shortly after the company launched its public service in San Diego on September 1, 2026, and expanded operations toward La Jolla in late October.

stories.title: US Invests $1.24 Billion in Rail Crossing Safety Projects
stories.summary: The US Department of Transportation announced 91 grants totaling 1.24 billion USD on 30 October 2026 to eliminate highway-rail crossing conflicts across 37 states. The Texas Department of Transportation will receive 46 million USD to construct a grade-separated overpass in Fort Worth.

also.title: $1.2B Rail Funding Package Covers 91 Crossing Projects; Only 37 Include Construction

stories.title: AIRO Group Secures First U.S. Government Drone Sale With RQ-35 and RQ-70 Platforms
stories.summary: AIRO Group Holdings completed its first U.S. government sale of RQ-35 and RQ-70 drone platforms to an unidentified federal customer. The transaction follows the RQ-35's July 2026 addition to the Defense Contract Management Agency Blue UAS List, establishing a past performance record for future contract evaluations.

stories.title: Tesla's Full Self-Driving didn't promise full autonomy, court rules as 88 owners lose refund bid
stories.summary: The Seoul Central District Court ruled on Oct. 29 that Tesla fulfilled its contractual duties, denying refunds to 88 owners who claimed the Full Self-Driving software promised Level 5 automation. The court found that delivering remaining features depended on technological progress and regulatory approval, and that buyers understood these functions might take a long time to become available.

also.title: Tesla removes ‘Full Self-Driving’ branding in Europe including in UK

stories.title: Wounded Ukrainian soldier rescued after 57 days on front line in third aerial drone evacuation
stories.summary: Soldiers from the 475th CODE 9.2 Assault Regiment used a StarGate drone to rescue a 54-year-old soldier stranded for 57 days near the Russian border. The aircraft flew more than 15 kilometers each way to extract the injured trooper, marking the third such aerial evacuation by the unit.

stories.title: Tesla Expands Texas Robotaxi Operations with Fort Worth Launch
stories.summary: Tesla launched its Robotaxi service in Fort Worth, Texas, at 6 a.m. on Monday, giving riders access to the autonomous ride-hailing service for the first time. The expansion follows a one-week-old service area expansion in Houston and a recent extension of operating hours to 6 a.m. through 2 a.m.

RAF uses Protector RG1 drone to monitor Russian warships in the English Channel for the first time
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force deployed its Protector RG1 drone for the first time on operational surveillance missions against Russian naval vessels in UK airspace between late September and mid-October. The uncrewed aircraft conducted more than ten hours of monitoring over the English Channel alongside Royal Navy ships and helicopters, tracking the Russian frigate Neustrashimy.

Britain's driverless dream hits a roundabout of awkward questions
stories.summary: The Institute for Driverless Transport asked the UK government to answer questions about infrastructure planning and employment impacts before proceeding further with autonomous vehicles. The group cited a lack of clarity on fallback options if foreign suppliers withdraw and who should lead the response, noting that authorities still lack specific plans for local infrastructure and labor market effects.

stories.title: Pulse Equity: Gix Internet’s Autonomous Robots Take On Critical Hospital Logistics Roles at One of the World’s Top Hospitals - Here’s Why It Matters
stories.summary: Gix Internet announced that autonomous robots operated by deliverz.ai began transporting blood and bone marrow specimens at Sheba Medical Center on October 12, 2026. The company also initiated a process to voluntarily delist its ordinary shares from the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, with the last trading day expected in January 2027.

stories.title: Agibot proposes Worken as a measure of robot productivity
Westborough reps, residents want Amazon's drone program to stay grounded
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its request to begin drone delivery in Westborough after residents expressed concerns. The proposed program would have used drones to fly small packages to customers within a 7.5 mile radius of Amazon's Westborough warehouse.

also.title: Amazon Withdraws Westborough Drone Pad, Promises a Revised Plan Soon

stories.title: Xpeng CEO expects Level 4 autonomous driving deployment in late 2028
stories.summary: Xpeng received approval to conduct Level 4 robotaxi demonstration operations in Guangzhou, allowing it to test its service model in public. CEO He Xiaopeng expects Level 4 deployment in late 2028, with regulation following between 2028 and 2032.

also.title: XPeng Shares Jump as EV Maker Scores Major Robotaxi Breakthrough

stories.title: Foundry Robotics Raises $100M for AI-Native Defense Factory, Acquires Avec Robotics
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics closed a $100 million Series A and acquired Avec Robotics to build an autonomous factory for complex assembly. Marlinspike Partners led the round, which included investors Khosla Ventures, Red Glass Ventures, SE Ventures, Wing VC, Axiom Ventures, Hanabi, and Zero Shot Fund. The company uses Vision-Language-Action models and the acquired Sentinel platform to allow remote human control when AI encounters novel tasks.

Vietnam signs turnkey contracts for Hanoi Metro's five driverless lines spanning 253.5 km
stories.summary: Hanoi signed turnkey contracts with a Vinhomes and SGC Investment consortium for five driverless metro lines spanning 253.5 km. The projects, covering Lines 1, 2, 8, 10, and 14, target completion by 2030 and will use Grade of Automation 4 standards.

stories.title: Percepto Launches Axion Physical AI Platform for Autonomous Drone and Infrastructure Inspections
stories.summary: Percepto launched Axion, a hardware-agnostic Physical AI platform that uses more than 160 specialized artificial intelligence models trained on over 100,000 hours of real-world autonomous inspection data to analyze drone and sensor information. The software-as-a-service offering allows organizations to identify equipment problems and prioritize maintenance without relying on a single drone manufacturer, and Percepto simultaneously announced a multi-year contract with a major U.S. energy company for transmission line inspection analytics.

stories.title: China invests heavily in embodied AI for robotics
stories.summary: Chinese embodied AI companies raised $13 billion across 322 deals in the first half of 2026, a five-fold increase from the prior year, according to ITjuzi. This investment surge reflects a shift from robot hardware to advanced AI software that allows robots to learn and adapt without extensive pre-programming.

Self-Driving Cars Market worth 51,213 thousand units in 2035
stories.summary: MarketsandMarkets projects the self-driving cars market will grow from 31,509 thousand units in 2026 to 51,213 thousand units in 2035, at a 5.5% compound annual growth rate. The report notes that Level 3 systems are expected to be the fastest-growing segment, with China approving its first two Level 3 passenger car models in December 2025.

Toyota & Waymo to Begin Scaling Autonomous Japanese Fleet
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo announced plans to test an autonomous Toyota bZ4X fleet in Japan in 2027, with deployment to the United Kingdom and other markets planned for the following years. All vehicles will be built at Toyota’s Takaoka plant in Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.

stories.title: Joby Launches Electric Air Taxi Flights Across Florida Under FAA eVTOL Pilot Program
stories.summary: Joby Aviation launched a week-long series of piloted electric air taxi flights across Florida, demonstrating its eVTOL aircraft in Tampa Bay, Orlando and the Space Coast under the FAA’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. The campaign includes a flight from Albert Whitted Airport to Tampa International Airport, a landing at a new vertiport near Orlando International Airport’s Terminal C, and a demonstration at Kennedy Space Center’s Shuttle Landing Facility.
